name: When should I consider a roof health assessment if I'm selling my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a roof health assessment if I'm selling my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you're planning to sell your home, a roof health assessment is a valuable tool to identify any issues that might deter potential buyers or cause delays in closing. Addressing problems proactively can prevent last-minute surprises during buyer inspections and provide confidence to prospective buyers. Having a recent assessment from a local DFW company like ours can also help in negotiations, demonstrating transparency and the proactive maintenance of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a roof health assessment before selling your home to identify and address issues, prevent delays, and provide transparency to potential buyers.
